'''''Leavetaking''''', and its plural, are the titles of four different chapters in ''[[The Wheel of Time]]'' series:

* ''[[The Eye of the World/Chapter 10|Leavetaking]]'' - the tenth chapter of ''[[The Eye of the World]]''.
* ''[[The Great Hunt/Chapter 9|Leavetakings]]'' - the ninth chapter of ''[[The Great Hunt]]''.
* ''[[The Shadow Rising/Chapter 16|Leavetakings]]'' - the sixteenth chapter of ''[[The Shadow Rising]]''.
* ''[[The Fires of Heaven/Chapter 48|Leavetakings]]'' - the forty-eighth chapter of ''[[The Fires of Heaven]]''.

''{{TVlink|Leavetaking}}'' is the title of the first episode of the [[The Wheel of Time (TV series)|television series]].

==See also==
